prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of Cloudflare Workers on the free plan (requests per day, CPU time per request). Cite Cloudflare's own documentation and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here are the officially documented limits for the Cloudflare Workers free plan regarding daily requests and CPU time.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/ | QUOTE: "Subrequests (fetch API) 50 subrequests Free plan" | CLAIM: The free plan allows 50 subrequests per Worker invocation, though the primary focus of the research is requests per day and CPU time.
SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/ | QUOTE: "Workers Free plan" "100,000 requests per day" | CLAIM: The free plan has a limit of 100,000 requests per day.
SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/ | QUOTE: "10 ms CPU time per invocation" | CLAIM: The free plan has a limit of 10 milliseconds of CPU time per request/invocation.
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: N/A (All requested limits—requests per day and CPU time per request—were found explicitly documented in the Cloudflare limits documentation).
